c193.title: Wow, Max's New Flat!
c193.story:
Max: Come in, Anna! This is my new flat.
Anna: [[Wow|wow]]! Look at the view from this window!
Max: Thanks. And this is my new lamp.
Anna: [[Ah|ah]], it looks like a big orange fish. [[Huh|huh]]? Does it really work?
Max: Yes, it does! Now look at my new jacket.
Anna: [[Oho|oho]], very nice! [[Ooh la la|ooh la la]], you look like a movie star!
Max: Now come into the kitchen.
Anna: [[OMG]], what a mess! [[Caramba|caramba]], are those old pizza boxes?
Max: Sorry! But [[voila]], my fridge is full of juice.
Max: Wait, what is under this box? [[Eureka|eureka]]! My lost keys!
Anna: Great! Now let's clean this kitchen together.

c194.title: Oops! A Bad Morning
c194.story:
Taras: [[Oops|oops]]! I dropped my phone in the hall.
Mama: Is it OK, Taras?
Taras: Yes, it's fine. [[Brr|brr]], the bathroom is so cold this morning!
Mama: Sorry, the heater is broken. Come and eat your soup.
Taras: [[Feh|feh]], the soup is cold too.
Grandpa: [[Fie|fie]] on this cold house! I sound like an old king in a film.
Anna: [[Boo|boo]]!
Taras: Anna! Don't jump out from behind the door!
Mama: Here, everyone. I made hot pancakes.
Taras: [[Mmm|mmm]], they're so good! Now my morning is better.

c195.title: Ha-Ha! Movie Night
c195.story:
Dad: Look, the dog is wearing Grandpa's hat! [[Ha|ha]]!
Dad: And now he's dancing! [[Ha-ha-ha|ha-ha-ha]]!
Anna: [[Heh|heh]], it's a really funny movie.
Taras: [[Ha-ha|ha-ha]]! I'm sending this part to my friends. I wrote "[[hehe]]."
Sofia: [[Hee-hee|hee-hee]]! The dog fell into the cake!
Grandpa: [[Ho-ho|ho-ho]], what do we have here? A dog in a Santa hat!
Grandpa: [[Ho-ho-ho|ho-ho-ho]]! Merry Christmas, little dog!
Mama: Everyone is laughing. This is our best movie night.

c196.title: Stop! Bravo!
c196.story:
Max: [[Stop|stop]]! Nobody can go into the castle!
Anna: [[Psst|psst]], Max, you're on the wrong side of the stage.
Teacher: [[Achtung|achtung]], everyone! Just a joke. Now the ship scene, please.
Teacher: [[Basta|basta]]! No more phones on stage.
Taras: [[Mayday|mayday]]! Our plane is falling into the sea!
Anna: We see the plane! Send an [[SOS]] to the coast!
Dad: [[Bravo|bravo]]! What a great show!
Grandma: [[Bravissimo|bravissimo]]! I loved every minute.
Sofia: [[Olé|ole]]! Max, you were the best guard!
Grandpa: [[Vivat|vivat]], young actors!
Max: Thank you! Next time I want to shout "[[banzai]]" like soldiers in old films.

c197.title: Meow, Moo, Bam!
c197.story:
Anna: Grandma's village is so quiet. I can finally read my book.
Max: Listen, the kitten says "[[meow]]." It wants food.
Anna: And the cow outside says "[[moo]]."
Grandpa: [[Bam|bam]]! Sorry, the wind closed the door.
Max: Now a car is going "[[beep-beep]]" outside the gate.
Anna: And the old clock in the hall goes "[[tick-tack]]."
Grandma: [[La-la|la-la]]... I forgot the words of my song.
Grandma: [[La-la-la|la-la-la]]... [[Tra-la-la|tra-la-la]]! Dinner is ready!
Anna: This village isn't quiet, Grandma, but I love it.

c198.title: GG! Game Night
c198.story:
Taras: Look at my hero's funny new hat!
Dmytro: [[LOL]], it looks like a banana!
Oleh: [[Kek|kek]], that's the best hat in the game.
Dmytro: Why did the robot cross the road? To charge his phone. [[Bazinga|bazinga]]!
Taras: Oh no, the screen says "[[Game over|game over]]."
Oleh: Good match, everyone. [[GG]]!
Mama: Taras, dinner! All this game talk is just [[blah blah blah]] to me.
Taras: OK, Mama, I'm coming!

c199.title: Ciao! Hello Around the World
c199.story:
Max: What's in your notebook, Anna?
Anna: Hello and goodbye words from my trips and friends.
Anna: In Italy, people say "[[ciao]]" and "[[arrivederci]]."
Max: And in Mexico?
Anna: "[[Adios|adios]]." My friend from Paris says "[[adieu]]."
Max: What about Hawaii?
Anna: There they say "[[aloha]]." In Japan, I learned "[[konnichiwa]]" and "[[sayonara]]."
Max: And India?
Anna: My yoga teacher says "[[namaste]]." Her mother says "[[namaskar]]."
Max: Cool! Please teach me all of them tomorrow.

c200.title: Words of Faith and Peace
c200.story:
Anna: This evening of many faiths is lovely, and everyone greets me so warmly.
Mr. Levin: [[Shalom|shalom]], Anna! Welcome to our evening.
Anna: Thank you! Look, there's Amira, my friend from university.
Amira: [[Salaam|salaam]], Anna! I'm so happy you came.
Anna: Will you come to my birthday party next Saturday?
Amira: [[Inshallah|inshallah]], I'll be there with a cake.
Anna: How is your mother? I heard she was sick.
Amira: [[Alhamdulillah|alhamdulillah]], she's much better now.
Max: Listen, the church choir is starting. They're singing "[[Alleluia|alleluia]]."
Anna: And now the "[[Ave|ave]] Maria." It's so beautiful and calm.
Amira: We use different words, but tonight we all wish each other peace.
